title: The One Who's Not Busy, Part 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's main teaching emphasizes that our individual experiences are interconnected with everything around us, allowing us to see ourselves as part of a larger system rather than separate individuals. This understanding can help cultivate compassion and cooperation by recognizing the complexity of our experiences. Through practices like sesshin meditation, we can explore this interconnectedness and develop greater awareness and presence in our daily lives, leading to a more nuanced and open approach to reality.
